statement: Build DevRelay's ArchitectureDesign module from the user-approved interactive requirements: deterministically select baseline establishment or change design from project state, execute a configured designer-to-modeler-to-decision-recorder chain, and emit one provider-neutral architecture candidate for a separate Architecture Gate.
objectives: Expose one ArchitectureDesign module with establish-baseline and design-change operations.
Route from persistent project architecture state without model or plug-in discretion.
Execute exact configured adapters in the declared designer, modeler, decision-recorder order.
Emit exactly one ArchitectureDraft or ArchitectureChangeSetDraft containing all supporting sections and attachments.
Require ArchitectureDiscovery before baseline establishment for an existing repository with no current architecture snapshot.
Preserve exact stage, adapter, source, and normalization provenance.
constraints: ArchitectureDesign consumes an approved RequirementsBaseline and never approves its own output.
The Architecture Gate alone promotes or updates an ArchitectureBaseline.
V1 defaults are SpecKitPlanAdapter or OpenSpecDesignAdapter, followed by StructurizrAdapter and MADRAdapter.
Named tools remain replaceable adapters and must not create identifier branches in core.
Interface intent belongs here; detailed OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, protobuf, data-schema generation, and enforcement remain downstream.
The first implementation remains a small local deterministic contract runner, not a distributed workflow platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Project state without an architecture baseline selects establish-baseline; state with a baseline selects design-change.
An existing undiscovered repository routes to ArchitectureDiscovery rather than invoking ArchitectureDesign.
The configured adapters resolve and execute only in designer, modeler, decision-recorder order.
Baseline establishment emits exactly one ArchitectureDraft and change design emits exactly one ArchitectureChangeSetDraft.
Both primary artifacts contain or reference technical design, architecture model, diagrams, interface intent, architecture constraints, decision records, and native artifacts.
Malformed state, stage handoffs, adapter bindings, provenance, references, or primary outputs are rejected before progression.
The full test suite passes without architecture or provider identifiers in generic core branches.
assumptions: ArchitectureDesign 0.1.0 is not yet published; the invalid provisional definition can be replaced rather than versioned.
The configured OpenSpec chat bridge records requirements provenance but does not claim OpenSpec CLI execution.
Supporting attachments remain subordinate to one primary module output.
